NONE: A1 belonging to or relating to something that has already been mentioned

example: The dog hurt its paw.
狗的爪子受傷了。
Their house has its own swimming pool.
他們的房子帶有游泳池。
The company increased its profits.
公司的利潤增加了。
I prefer the second option - its advantages are simplicity and cheapness.
我傾向於第二個選擇——其優點是簡單、便宜。
It's my turn to do it.
輪到我了。
It's been a wonderful day - thank you.
這一天過得真愉快——謝謝你。

NONE: A2 used when the subject of the verb is "it" and the object is the same thing, animal, situation, or idea
B1 used to emphasize the subject when it is a thing, animal, situation, or idea
只為自己使用地，不公開地

example: The cat licked itself all over.
貓把自己的身體整個舔了一遍。
You have to do something about the problem - it isn't just going to resolve itself.
你得做點什麼了——這個問題不會自行解決的。
The shop itself (= only the shopand nothing else) started 15 years ago but the internet side of the business is new.
這家商店15年前就開業了，但網路業務卻是新增的。
The animal had been left in the house by itself for a week.
這個動物被孤零零地留在了房子裡一個星期。
A cough will usually get better by itself.
咳嗽一般自己會好的。
The committee kept the results of the survey to itself (= did not tell anyone), fearing a bad public reaction.
委員會擔心會引發不好的公眾反應，因此沒有公開調查結果。
She has these itsy-bitsy little hands and feet.
她的手和腳都非常小。
